# @tansy/pwned-passwords

Refuses passwords found in known breaches, checked against Have I Been Pwned by hash range.

```bash
npm install @tansy/pwned-passwords
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the pwned-passwords plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/pwned-passwords.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
